query.query: A car pulls away.
A car stops.
Someone opens the back of a car.
Someone comes out through a doorway of a building and steps outside into view.
Someone opens the door of a small building.
A car comes up to a corner, slows and makes a right turn.
Someone with their head down, thumbing out a message on their phone.
Someone opens a car door and gets in.
Someone puts something down.
Someone hauling something big and heavy, holding it with both arms.
A big white coach bus with dark stripes down the side, stopped at the curb by a walkway, shuts its front door as someone walks past.
Two people standing and chatting next to a white pickup truck in front of the small grey building, near orange cones and workers in yellow vests.
A dark red car turning around.
A person in dark clothes shutting the trunk of a dark car in the back row of the parking lot.
Someone getting into a dark car.
Someone opening the door of a white car.
Someone shutting the door of the small grey building where people in yellow safety vests are hanging around.
Someone in dark clothes stepping out from behind a shelter.
A silver SUV dropping someone off at the front of the big tan brick building.
A cyclist went along the sidewalk past the tall flagpole.
Two people stopped with their bikes on the walkway near the flagpole, and one of them was loading something onto a bike.
A worker in a yellow safety vest lugging something heavy by the line of orange cones on the road, next to a white pickup.
Someone getting into a dark car parked at the main entrance of the brick building.
In the gym, one person handed something to another over by the folding chairs.
Somebody walked out through the door at the top of the bleachers in the gym.
Someone opening a door to one of the buildings.
Saw somebody shut the back hatch of a white SUV over in the parking lot.
Someone reached out and touched another person in a crowd.
A big boxy vehicle, maybe a bus, pulled away from the far end of the walkway by the light poles while a handful of people walked along the path.
A car rolled up and stopped.
A car pulling out way off in the distance.
A dark minivan pulled up and stopped at the front entrance of the big tan brick building, right by the hedges, with a silver car out on the road.
A white SUV pulling away from near the stop sign behind the parked cars.
A grey car pulled in and stopped beside a couple of parked cars in front of the low white building with the blue awning, across the lot from the orange lift.
